description: An orange tracked over-snow vehicle with an enclosed cab rides on two caterpillar tracks across snow and ice. A roof rack carries rope coils, a rust-red barrel and green canvas bags, and oil drums are strapped at the rear. Thin flags on poles stand in the snow at left, under a dark, stormy polar sky. No letters, frame or gore are visible, and the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.
reason: Shows an orange tracked snow vehicle crossing ice, but the card is the nuclear icebreaker Lenin, a ship. The picture needs a ship breaking ice in Arctic water.
